features.title: Check hierarchy overview
features.userOutcome: Show canonical check/status outcomes; classify required/advisory only with current requirement evidence, otherwise unknown.
features.boundaryAcceptance: Checks/Commit statuses read are optional feature grants; denied or partial sources never become zero failures, and skipped legs never count as successful required evidence.
features.dataSource: Integration 11.2: Checks read check-runs at the full head SHA, Commit statuses read contexts, and explicitly labeled loaded native requirement evidence; Action assessment remains separate.
features.privacy: session-first-private-data; no telemetry; redacted exports; explicit persistence only for authored personal state
features.activation: eligibility before mount; user gesture for reads beyond the current page, drafts, writes and optional grants
features.coexistence: omit equivalent native control; explain loaded scope; preserve native content, drafts, checks and recovery
features.accessibility: keyboard/focus, screen reader, 200% zoom/320 CSS px, themes, reduced motion; complete en/es/fr/pt

tests.scenario: With selected-repository Checks read and Commit statuses read, canonical full-head check runs and status contexts are shown separately; current native requirement evidence classifies requiredness and its absence yields unknown.
A skipped matrix leg never becomes successful required evidence, and a successful advisory/unknown-policy check never establishes merge readiness.

Denied Checks/Commit statuses read, truncated pagination or stale evidence shows source-specific unavailable/partial states with native links, retaining only labeled loaded-native rows and never claiming zero failures.
Changing the selected repository/account/revision while check hierarchy overview is loading prevents the late result from rendering.
